Introduction
Note: Use the Table of Contents present at the bottom of the channel, or in the pinned comments, to quickly navigate through this channel and find the information you are looking for.
​
Some general notes:
⬥ The game runs on an internal tick system: 1t (tick) = 0.6s (seconds).
⬥ The minimum time between abilities is called the global cooldown: 1 gcd = 3t = 1.8s.
⬥ Auto attacks will only give adrenaline if they hit (splash = no adrenaline gain).
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Debuff spells like Vuln  or Enfeeble  or Smoke Cloud  do not give adrenaline.
⬥ Some useful sheets and resources are given below.
​



















Ability Damage Maths
To calculate your ability hit damage in detail, click here.
This is affected by factors such as your gear and other boosts.
Ability Hit Timings
To see detailed breakdowns on ability hit timings, click here.
This refers to when hitsplats appear on your target.
Auto-attack Adren Gain
To see adrenaline gained with different auto attacks, click here.








Note: If you have any difficulties in using the tools or understanding what the information means, you can always ask in #pvm-help.
​
Constitution 
This section covers auto attacks, basics, thresholds, ultimate abilities and special attacks for Defence.
​
Autos

















Default Auto 

⬥ Cooldown: Based on Weapon Speed
    • Fastest: 4t (2.4s)
    • Fast: 5t (3.0s)
    • Average: 6t (3.6s)
⬥ Takes on style of main hand weapon









​
Basics

















Siphon 

⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s)
⬥ Only works on targets with more adrenaline than you









​

















Sacrifice 

⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s)
⬥ Heal for 25% of your damage dealt
    • Increased to 100% if killing hit









​

















Storm Shards 

⬥ Cooldown: 50t (30s)
⬥ Stacks delayed ability damage on target
    • Up to 10 stacks
    • Damage is triggered by using 
⬥ Damage when triggered is dependant on weapon which applied the 









​

















Regenerate 

⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s)
⬥ Must be out of combat to use
⬥ Trades 10% adrenaline for 2% of max health per tick until either
    • Health is full; or
    • Adrenaline is empty; or
    • Combat is initiated









​

















Eat Food 

⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s)
⬥ Eats food









​

















Tuska's Wrath 

⬥ Cooldown: 200t (120s)
    • 25t (15s) if used on non slayer target
⬥ If enemy is your active slayer target, it will do 100*(Slayer level damage)
    • All bosses except The Magister are immune to this effect









​
Thresholds

















Reprisal 

⬥ Cooldown: 100t (60s)
⬥ Duration: 10t (6s), or  is cast again
⬥ Stores incoming damage while active (up to 30,000)
⬥ Stored damage dealt to target at end of duration









​

















Shatter 

⬥ Cooldown: 200t (120s)
⬥ Unleashes all Storm Shards  on target
⬥ Maximum hit of 30,000
⬥ Damage is based on weapon which applied  , but effected by damage boosts when  is used









​
Special Attacks

















Essence of Finality 

⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s)
⬥ Adrenaline cost: dependant on weapon stored in Essence of Finality 
⬥ main hand weapon must be of the same style as weapon stored






This ability requires an Essence of Finality with a stored weapon



​

















Weapon Special Attack 

⬥ Cooldown: 0t (0s)
    • Some weapons have their own weapon specific cooldown
⬥ Duration: dependant on weapon









​
Ultimates

















Guthix's Blessing 

⬥ Cooldown: 500t (300s)
⬥ Duration: 16t (9.6s)
⬥ Every 4t (1.6s) heal for 8% of your max HP
    • Enemies may target the butterfly and end effects early
⬥ Shares cooldown with 









​

















Ice Asylum 

⬥ Cooldown: 500t (300s)
⬥ Duration: 34t (22.2s)
⬥ Heals players nearby for 1 - 7% of their max HP (based on proximity) every 6t (3.6s)
⬥ Healing capacity of 300% of your max HP
⬥ Shares cooldown with 









​

















Onslaught 

⬥ Cooldown: 200t (120s)
⬥ Channeled ability
⬥ Up to 26 hits
    • Drain adrenaline 25 at per hit to 0
    • Subsequent hits damage you for 25% of the outgoing hit









​

















Transfigure 

⬥ Cooldown: 300t (180s)
⬥ Duration: 10t (6s) of incapacitation, then 25t (15s) of stun and bind immunity
⬥ Heal for 250% of damage taken during incapacitation, when it ends, up to a maximum 75% of max HP









​

















 Constitution Ability Index 

⬥ Click the links to quickly navigate to that ability's information.
⬥ General notes can be found in the introduction here.
